headline_marked: 20 injured as [[BNP activists attack NCP rally]] in Kurigram
headline: 20 injured as BNP activists attack NCP rally in Kurigram
summary: National Citizen Party (NCP) members were reportedly attacked with sticks and local weapons during a protest march in Phulbari Upazila.
details: At least 20 leaders and activists of the National Citizen Party's (NCP) student wing, Jatiya Chhatrashakti, were injured in an attack on their protest march in Phulbari Upazila, Kurigram.
The attack occurred around 5:30 PM on Thursday. The injured, including several senior district and upazila officials, were admitted to the Upazila Health Complex and other local hospitals.

NCP members claim the protest was a peaceful march against attacks on their party members in Habiganj. They allege that BNP and its affiliate organizations, including Chhatra Dal and Jubo Dal, attacked them with sticks and local weapons.
Mukul Mia, the Kurigram district convener of the NCP, stated that over 200 people from the BNP and its affiliates launched the attack on their peaceful program.

A former general secretary of the Phulbari Upazila BNP has denied the allegations, claiming instead that Chhatra League activists participated in the NCP rally and that the incident was a clash between NCP and Chhatra Dal members.

The Officer-in-Charge of Phulbari Police Station, Mahmud Hasan Naim, confirmed that BNP activists attacked the NCP rally. He stated that police were present at the scene but the attackers fled before they could intervene.
Police have stated that legal action will be taken following a formal complaint from the NCP.

headline_marked: US Envoy Sergio Gor says [[Bangladesh-US ties moving in positive direction]]
headline: US Envoy Sergio Gor says Bangladesh-US ties moving in positive direction
summary: The US special envoy for President Donald Trump met with Foreign Minister Dr. Khalilur Rahman in Dhaka to discuss strengthening bilateral relations.
details: US President Donald Trump's special envoy, Sergio Gor, held successful discussions with Bangladesh's Foreign Minister Dr. Khalilur Rahman in Dhaka.
In a post on X (formerly Twitter) on Thursday, Gor stated that he was pleased to meet the Foreign Minister during his first visit to Bangladesh.
The envoy highlighted that the talks were productive and focused on how both nations can work together to further strengthen their bilateral relationship.
Gor expressed optimism about the future, noting that there are many positive developments and possibilities ahead for the two countries.
Sergio Gor, who also serves as the US Ambassador to India, arrived in Dhaka on Thursday afternoon for a three-day visit.
The envoy is scheduled to return to Delhi on Saturday after concluding his diplomatic mission in Bangladesh.
caption:
Positive progress for diplomacy! US Special Envoy Sergio Gor confirms that Bangladesh-US ties are moving in a positive direction.

US President Donald Trump's special envoy, Sergio Gor, held successful discussions with Bangladesh's Foreign Minister Dr. Khalilur Rahman in Dhaka.

In a post on X (formerly Twitter) on Thursday, Gor stated that he was pleased to meet the Foreign Minister during his first visit to Bangladesh.

The envoy highlighted that the talks were productive and focused on how both nations can work together to further strengthen their bilateral relationship.

Gor expressed optimism about the future, noting that there are many positive developments and possibilities ahead for the two countries.

Sergio Gor, who also serves as the US Ambassador to India, arrived in Dhaka on Thursday afternoon for a three-day visit.

The envoy is scheduled to return to Delhi on Saturday after concluding his diplomatic mission in Bangladesh.
